proof_scope: alias routing is checked against real alias/canonical skill files; adversarial temp copy removes canonical composition to prove fail-closed behavior

claims.proves: the singular alias routes to the canonical plural Pi-extension standard, carries typo triggers, composes agentic-evals, and has an executable eval fixture
claims.does_not_prove: that Pi's runtime selector will choose this alias in every prompt wording, or that any future extension implementation is correct

capability_claims.description: the alias composes the canonical plural standard and retains typo-compatible triggers

cases.name: alias-missing-canonical-compose-is-rejected
command:
T=$(mktemp -d); cp -R .. "$T/alias"; python3 - "$T/alias/SKILL.md" "$T/alias/README.md" "$T/alias/PROJECT_KNOWLEDGE.md" "$T/alias/fixtures/agentic_eval.json" <<'PY'
import pathlib, sys
for raw in sys.argv[1:]:
    p = pathlib.Path(raw)
    text = p.read_text()
    text = text.replace('best-practices-pi-extensions', 'parallel-pi-extension-standard')
    p.write_text(text)
PY
python3 ../../best-practices-pi-extensions/scripts/check_pi_extension_standard.py --skill-dir ../../best-practices-pi-extensions --alias-dir "$T/alias"; rc=$?; rm -rf "$T"; exit $rc
